status: Implemented native GitPanel; host integration owned by root agent
build: add_subdirectory(src/git/ui); ade_git_ui links ade_git, ade_editor, Qt6::Widgets. Backend ade_git stays QtCore-only.

api.workspace: setWorkspaceContext(hostTrustedContext); setWorkspace(path, conversationId). A conversation ID is required to distinguish different chats sharing the same repository.
api.mutations: setMutationGuard(path,operation) runs before submitting Git work. mutationStarted and mutationFinished notify the host of in-flight paths. False guard response performs no Git action.
api.mount: mountWorktreeRequested(path,setupMetadata) fires only after successful creation in the original UI context, or an explicit existing-worktree selection. Host attaches the correct conversation, then starts setup using nonempty metadata.
api.remove: worktreeRemovalStarted before request; worktreeRemoved only after Git success; worktreeRemovalFinished after result. Host detaches surviving chats only on successful removal, and blocks remount during removal.
api.order: mutationFinished occurs before mountWorktreeRequested so the host can release mutation guards before mounting.
api.edit: openDiffRequested(workspace,path,false,oldPath) asks the host to open the working file in its byte-preserving editor. Both preview panes remain readonly.
api.stale_contexts: Pending read results are ignored after context change. Filesystem mutations already in flight finish, but their old-context creation results cannot mount into a newly active chat. The current context is refreshed afterward.

implemented: Native branch/worktree action bar and Changes/Worktrees tabs
Fresh repository status counts, changed files, staged markers, added/deleted counts, rename paths and binary indicators
HEAD/index versus HEAD/working-file selection with native CodeEditor line gutters and syntax; UTF8/UTF16 decoding through TextFileIO
Readonly index snapshots and explicit working-file editor signal
Branch source selection from actual available local/remote refs, explicit remote fetch and refresh result
Local branch switching with branches already checked out elsewhere disabled
Create branch/worktree dialogs, names generated using the exact pinned 911-adjective/953-noun source wordbank and collision avoidance
Worktree tree with main/current/locked state and source-backed creation-time ordering
Main-worktree deletion disabled; fresh deletion info; dirty Delete anyway confirmation; branches retained; ignored-file loss explained for clean removal
Host dirty-editor/busy-run veto callback, affected-path signals and stale chat-response suppression
Visible-panel five-second refresh fallback and explicit refresh, retaining selected preview and updating external file changes

validation.platform: Qt offscreen plugin: dialogs, tests and raster renders do not display, focus or interact with the user's desktop windows
coverage: untrusted workspace rejection and disabled actions
readonly staged and working byte-preserving preview selection
main-delete and checked-out branch disabled states
dirty deletion cancel/confirm and start/finish/success signals
external modification refresh and removal of obsolete previews
same-repository different-chat creation cannot mount a late result

remaining_gaps: The side-by-side preview does not reproduce Monaco's aligned change hunks, intraline colors, minimap or advanced diff controls.
A dedicated Git changes sidebar and the exact upstream workspace popover layout remain visual integration work; this is a functional native pane.
Per-repository setup settings UI and cleanup candidate/snooze UI are not part of GitPanel, although backend APIs exist.
No stage/unstage/commit/push buttons were fabricated: those were not present in the examined pinned Git RPC contracts.
Polling is a visible-panel refresh fallback; native recursive filesystem/ref watcher parity remains future integration work.
Binary, submodule and symlink diff presentation remain limited as documented in the backend audit.
Host session persistence, unsaved editor handling, busy agent policy and setup-after-mount sequencing require the parent MainWindow integration and its own tests.
